lastCompletedStory.title: Mirror the red-on-main falsifiability rule into both auditor copies

nextStoryContext: Checklist item 9 in both .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md now carries a third paragraph (after the oracle-kinds paragraph and the -q/-L self-nullifying-oracle paragraph) mirroring the patterns.md:899 red-on-main falsifiability rule: it tells the auditor to treat an unverified/implausible/missing 'red-on-main' sweep annotation as a critical BLOCK finding, since the pure lint pipeline (prd-oracle-lint.ts) structurally cannot execute a candidate oracle against a worktree and this prose check is the only enforcement surface for that rule. The two copies remain byte-identical for the ENTIRE item 9 (verified via content-anchored awk extraction, now 7 lines each, up from 6 pre-story); any future edit to item 9 in either file must be mirrored verbatim into the other or this story's own AC2 pinning oracle (and any similar future oracle) will go red. templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md changed so src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` and committed alongside (embed-vendor:check confirmed clean). CAM-310's self-nullifying-oracle rule (the -q/-L paragraph) is the second paragraph of item 9; this story's red-on-main paragraph was appended as a third, distinct paragraph rather than merged into either existing one, keeping each rule independently greppable.
